EMANCIPATION.note: Renamed Emancipation Ave in 2017; listed as Dowling St (and East Broadway in early 1870s-1890s) in historic directories and Sanborn maps.
Early Third Ward maps and directories also referred to upper Dowling / Emancipation as East Broadway.

DOWLING.note: Renamed Emancipation Ave in 2017 (some HCAD tax parcels still carry the pre-2017 Dowling St situs).
Early Third Ward maps and directories also referred to upper Dowling / Emancipation as East Broadway.

HEIGHTS.note: Listed simply as 'Boulevard' (with 3-digit Houston Heights house numbers) prior to Houston's 1918 annexation of Houston Heights.

JENSEN.note: Lower Jensen Dr (Fifth Ward) appears as Odin Ave and Clark St in pre-1925 directories and 1907 Sanborn Vol. 1.
Northward continuation of Jensen Dr was historically indexed as Clark St.

W DALLAS.note: West Dallas St through Fourth Ward / Freedmen's Town was historically Old San Felipe Rd (and New San Felipe) on 1885-1925 maps.

DALLAS.note: West of Downtown through Fourth Ward / Freedmen's Town, W. Dallas St was historically San Felipe Rd.

NAVIGATION.note: Inner East End / Second Ward segments along Buffalo Bayou appear as German St (renamed Canal/Navigation era) and Harrisburg Rd.
East End thoroughfare corridors frequently cross-reference Harrisburg Rd.

CANAL.note: Canal St in Second Ward was listed as German St until World War I era street renamings (1918).

LOCKWOOD.note: Early Fifth Ward / East End tracts prior to Lockwood Dr grading were indexed by cross-street or railroad addition.

MONTROSE.note: Platted in 1911; search both 'Montrose' and 'Montrose Boul' in 1911-1926 directories.

ALLEN.note: Allen Parkway corridor was historically Buffalo Bayou Drive / San Felipe outskirts.

MEMORIAL.note: Memorial Dr corridor west of Downtown developed along Buffalo Dr / Washington Rd.

LAWNDALE.note: Early Country Club / East End parcels near Lawndale also reference Telephone Rd or Harrisburg additions.

ST JOSEPH.note: St. Joseph Pkwy downtown was historically Calhoun Ave on 1885-1951 Sanborn maps.

I-45.note: Elevated downtown freeway right-of-way followed Pierce Ave / Heiner St.

CHARTRES.note: Pre-1912 directories occasionally used block descriptions ('bet Congress and Preston') alongside 3- and 4-digit numbers.
